notes.title: Rage with 20% discount + DEMO available!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, Players![/h1]

🔥 Enjoy 20% OFF on Rage of the Dragons NEO during the Couch Co-Op Fest! The discount is available until the 17th, so don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2892130/Rage_of_the_Dragons_NEO/

[h2]DEMO AVAILABLE[/h2]

To celebrate the game's first discount, we've brought back the DEMO, which you can play until the end of the Fest!

In this DEMO, you'll find the offline modes, including Versus Mode and the exclusive Dragon’s Challenges, where you can take on multiple enemies in a series of unique battles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931538/02a8ae6421dc26529c12815ccc7ab7a2cb2d658e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Play Rage of the Dragons on Your Steam Deck![/h2]
The game runs really well on Deck! The only minor issue? Some text might be a bit small—but don't let that stop you from enjoying it on the go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931538/7ecf2103a36e40d278907a550cb6116223df6d88.png[/img]


💬 Got ideas, suggestions, or issues to share? Drop your feedback in the community forums or reach out to us directly!

🙏 Thank you so much for your support, and see you soon! 😉

notes.title: Rage of the Dragons NEO now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hi Rage Fans! 🐲

The wait is over! We’re thrilled to announce that [h2]Rage of the Dragons NEO is now officially available on Steam! 🔥 [/h2]

Dive into the epic world of 2D fighting, where every battle is a test of precision, and pure skill. This classic brings back the iconic tag team action with all the charm, charisma, and challenge that made it a fan-favorite in arcades.

If you played already, remember to [h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2892130/reviews/][b]Leave a Steam review[/b][/url]![/h3]

Keep reading to learn more 👇️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931538/6c68eb18848758f77be7cbb35bae2b04ffd21d44.png[/img]

Rage of the Dragons NEO is packed with:
[list]
[*] [b]Dual Combat System:[/b] 🤼 Choose two fighters and switch between them on the fly, crafting powerful combos and unique special moves to dominate your opponent.
[*] [b]Iconic Characters: [/b]🧑‍🎤 Each fighter has a distinct style and story, blending traditional and supernatural elements for a diverse roster.
[*] [b]Classic Arcade Mode:[/b] 🕹️ Relive the nostalgia and intensity of arcade battles as you fight your way to the top.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931538/2e58a4282fea2915e5e539f25ce53f1a015b1538.jpg[/img]

In addition, Rage of the Dragons NEO offers:
[list]
[*] [b]Versus Mode [/b]🆚
[*] [b]Training Mode[/b] 🏋️
[*] [b]Dragon Challenge[/b] 🐲 - an exclusive new mode for you to master
[*] [b]Ranked and Casual Matches with rollback netcode[/b] 🌐
[*] [b]Lobbies for up to 8 Players[/b] 💬
[*] [b]Replay with Takeover[/b] 🎥
[/list]

And for those looking to set the tone, the [b]Jukebox feature[/b] 🎶☺️ lets you pick your favorite tracks in the menus!

Jump into the action and see why Rage of the Dragons remains a beloved title in the world of fighting games. Thank you for your support, and let the battles begin!

💙 [b]Join our Discord[/b] to chat with the devs and other players: https://discord.gg/qubyte

👍️ [b]Leave a Steam review[/b], every one of them helps our game: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2892130/reviews/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931538/02a8ae6421dc26529c12815ccc7ab7a2cb2d658e.jpg[/img]

Don’t miss out on the trailer:

notes.title: Demo Available now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! How's it going?

We’d like to thank everyone who participated in the Closed Beta. It was amazing to share this experience with you! We're carefully reading all the feedback we received ♥

We also want to let you know that [b]Rage of the Dragons NEO[/b] now has a demo available!

During the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] (October 14–21), you’ll be able to try out some offline modes like Versus and the exclusive Dragon's Challenges 🐉

We’re still keeping a few features under wraps, but we hope you enjoy these modes!

Thank you so much for all your support, and see you soon 😉

notes.title: Closed Beta and Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! How are you all doing?

We have two exciting announcements to share today:

First, we are thrilled to announce the [b]Closed Beta[/b] for Rage of the Dragon NEO! In it, you will have the chance to test the online mode, experiencing breathtaking battles firsthand!

The Closed Beta will take place from October 11th to 13th, and registration is now open: https://tinyurl.com/ROTDBetaForm


[i]Don’t waste time, as the form will close on October 8th!
[/i]

[previewyoutube=-PRuQqLQTZw;full][/previewyoutube]

And the news doesn’t stop there! Rage of the Dragon NEO will also be part of the Steam Next Fest, from October 14th to 21st! During the event, you’ll be able to explore the single-player mode features, including:

[list]
[*] Versus Mode
[*] The brand-new “Dragon's Challenges”
[/list]

We’re excited to see you playing ROTD NEO, so don’t forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/qubyte]Discord[/url] channel so we can chat, answer questions, take suggestions, and more 😄

See you soon for some intense action 🔥🐉

*Training mode will no longer be available during Steam Next Fest, only versus and the exclusive mode, Dragon's Challenge
